description.p: Tanks Manager is a task manager for Linux desktops in the spirit of the Windows XP and Windows 7 originals: a process table you can actually read, and a performance view drawn on the old green-on-black plate. It is a plain GTK 3 application, so it picks up the same theme and icons as the rest of your desktop.

ul.li: A live process table with a filter, a process tree, per-process CPU, memory, disk and GPU use, and the systemd unit each process belongs to
Signals, priority and CPU affinity, plus a properties window covering open files, sockets, threads, memory maps and the environment
A Windows 10 style card strip in the Performance tab: CPU, memory, network, one card per drive and one per GPU
Per-core CPU meters with kernel time drawn separately, sampled from a real XP screenshot down to the exact palette
Memory broken out into drive swap, zram and zswap, so it is always clear which is which
Drives and GPUs appearing and disappearing while the window is open
